text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the Umamusume dedicated themselves to 
training even harder for the prestigious 
Classic races, Trainer Kashimoto and her 
team were putting in just as much effort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The support of the Three Goddesses played 
a massive role there, making their 
presence indispensable to other Trainers 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Trainer Kashimoto care for them so 
devotedly, Bitter Glasse and Little Cocon 
placed even greater trust in her than ever 
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Coupled with their growing abilities, the 
two feel deeply fulfilled. They vow to 
achieve results in the Classic races 
without fail.
